news.title: Zelenski asegura que Ucrania ha inutilizado más de la mitad de la capacidad de refinado de petróleo de Rusia
news.summary: El presidente de Ucrania, Volodimir Zelenski, ha asegurado este domingo que los ataques ucranianos han inutilizado ya "más del 55%" de la capacidad de refinado de Rusia.

news.title: IA reacende debate sobre renda básica universal na Alemanha
news.summary: Mercado de trabalho deverá ser profundamente afetado, com até 800 mil empregos eliminados em 15 anos. Economistas se dividem sobre viabilidade financeira da proposta para amortecer ruptura.

news.title: Na Amazônia, Leão 14 condena "exploração irresponsável" da floresta
news.summary: Pontífice citou produção de ouro e petróleo e pediu esclarecimento de assassinatos de lideranças indígenas. Viagem do chefe do Vaticano ao país adotivo causa alvoroço.

news.title: EUA e países aliados fazem acordo para proteger cadeia de IA da China
news.summary: Pacto reúne Japão, Austrália, Israel e Reino Unido e busca reduzir dependência de tecnologias e insumos estratégicos chineses

news.title: Dormir bem pode reduzir o risco de desenvolver 90 doenças, diz estudo
news.summary: Pesquisa com 95.000 pessoas associa fases REM e profunda mais longas a menor chance de doenças

news.title: Southeast Asian leaders open annual summit with major conflicts and their impact topping the agenda
news.summary: The ASEAN leaders are likely to renew calls for self-restraint and peaceful resolutions of conflicts, including longstanding disputes in the South China Sea and a civil war in Myanmar.

news.title: EUA receberam alertas sobre riscos em sistema que suspendeu voos
news.summary: Relatórios indicaram perigo de sobrecarga durante a modernização de uma rede antiga; pane na 6ª feira (13.nov) afetou mais de 10.000 voos

news.title: Yemen’s Houthis unilaterally release 600 war detainees
news.summary: Yemen’s Houthis have released 600 people imprisoned during the country’s civil war.

news.title: Ebola outbreak remains out of control in Congo 6 months into response
news.summary: More than 11,000 cases have been recorded, and nearly half of those infected have died, according to government data. It is the deadliest of Congo's 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.

news.title: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Spain's Canary Islands in two days
news.summary: Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached the Canary Islands over the past two days, Spain’s coastguard said Sunday, continuing a recent surge of arrivals from West African countries to the Spanish archipelago, where the authorities declared a migration emergency earlier this week.

news.title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
news.summary: Protesters say the move will stifle media freedom, while the government insists broadcasters need to cut costs.

news.title: La coalición saudí anuncia la intercepción de dos drones hutíes en La Meca y uno más en Medina
news.summary: La coalición militar internacional para Yemen liderada por Arabia Saudí ha informado este domingo de que han sido interceptados dos drones en la región de La Meca y uno más en la región de Medina, donde se encuentran las dos ciudades más sagradas del islam.

news.title: Goodbye, overtourism? Sustainable travel gains ground
news.summary: As tourism booms across Latin America, alternative forms of travel are gaining ground. Making your holiday more sustainable means rethinking who calls the shots, who invests and who benefits.

news.title: Photos: Pope Leo visits Peru’s Amazon and Andean regions during 12-day tour
news.summary: The pope has called for the preservation of Indigenous traditions in Peru as he wraps up a 12-day tour of Latin America.

news.title: Palestinians reclaim Gaza’s shores with a swim for hope
news.summary: For the first time in more than three years, Gaza’s swimming federation has held a competition.

news.title: França intercepta submarino com toneladas de cocaína
news.summary: Ocupantes tentaram fugir e afundaram embarcação, mas acabaram presos em operação inédita no Atlântico. Maioria da droga foi para o fundo do mar.

news.title: Who can force Israel to implement Gaza ceasefire deal?
news.summary: Storms batter Palestinian territory as Israel restricts entry of aid.

news.title: Estonia to close border crossings with Russia after alleged arson attack
news.summary: Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged arson attempt at a drone factory.

news.title: Jordan sentences three men to death over deadly church attack in Karak
news.summary: Jordan sentences three men to death over deadly church attack in Karak

news.title: El presidente argelino advierte de que el país está "inundado" de droga y amenaza con atacar el "origen"
news.summary: El presidente de Argelia, Abdelmayid Tebboune, ha advertido este domingo de la "inundación" de droga que sufre su país y ha adelantado que las autoridades atacarán en el "origen" este fenómeno, que las autoridades argelinas identifican en Marruecos

news.title: Africa CDC says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo ‘still not under control’
news.summary: 'If we don't stop this outbreak now, it would be the worst Ebola outbreak,' Africa ​CDC director says.

news.title: Polonesas driblam veto ao aborto com armário de entrega de pílulas
news.summary: 'Abortomat' se inspira em solução para receber encomendas de lojas online. Iniciativa enfrenta oposição de grupos católicos em país com uma das legislações mais restritivas da Europa.

news.title: Pope crosses Peru in the finale of a trip home to visit flock high in Andes and deep in Amazon
news.summary: On the penultimate day of his visit to his adopted homeland, Leo channeled Pope Francis by emphasizing Catholic teaching that links care for the most vulnerable with care for God's creation.

news.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
news.summary: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

news.title: Ronaldinho makes comeback in Ravenna win
news.summary: Brazil legend Ronaldinho makes his comeback aged 46 for Ravenna, playing the first half of their Italian third-tier derby against Forli.

news.title: Yemen's Houthis advance on Aden as government forces retreat to defend their capital
news.summary: Houthi forces in Yemen have advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden, the seat of the country's internationally recognised government, military and government sources said Sunday. The embattled government earlier announced it was pulling back its last forces from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to defend its temporary capital on the southern coast of Yemen.

news.title: Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide
news.summary: The US transport secretary says that normal air-traffic operations may not be restored until Monday.

news.title: Pragues's fight for public TV - Why Renowned Presenter Will Leave Czech TV Over Reforms
news.summary: Daniel Stach, one of the Czech Republic’s best-known television presenters, tells Gavin Lee on France 24 why he is prepared to walk away from his career rather than work under changes that he says will threaten the independence of public broadcasting. As hundreds of thousands take to the streets of Prague, Stach explains why he is joining the protests against the government’s proposed overhaul of public media funding – and what is at stake for Czech television, journalism and democracy.

news.title: Una ONG alerta de que "Senegal se está vaciando" y pide políticas de desarrollo para que la juventud no emigre
news.summary: El presidente de la ONG Horizontes Sin Fronteras, el hispano-senegalés Boubacar Sèye, ha alertado de que "Senegal se está vaciando" tras conocer las noticias de la llegada masiva de migrantes africanos a las islas Canarias, y ha pedido a las autoridades senegalesas políticas que fomenten el desarrollo económico para que la juventud no tenga que emigrar.

news.title: Israeli drone filmed flying low outside homes in southern Lebanon
news.summary: Video shows an Israeli drone flying at low altitude over a residential area in southern Lebanon.

news.title: O ídolo do judô que está sacudindo a eleição presidencial da França com candidatura surpresa
news.summary: Com discurso contra extremismo, o pentacampeão olímpico Teddy Riner é uma das figuras mais populares da França contemporânea, e um em cada cinco eleitores afirma que poderia apoiá-lo na eleição.

news.title: Zelenskyy says Starshield restrictions threaten Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter
news.summary: Restrictions on Ukraine's Starshield satellite communications system are hindering its ability to intercept Russian drones, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Sunday.
